Australia Tightens Visa Rules for International Students

Australia has announced significant changes to its visa regulations, restricting most international students from bringing family members into the country. This policy shift aims to reduce net overseas migration. The government stated that the changes are part of a broader strategy to ensure the integrity of the student visa system and to address concerns about the rising number of dependents accompanying students. Previously, many international students were permitted to bring partners and children, but the new rules significantly curtail this option for most.
